A '''[[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]''' under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Comeg]] was stationed in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. The prototype [[World Devastator]] ''[[Silencer-7]]'' was attached to the fleet, before being sent to [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]].<ref name="DESB" />
